issues.reason: Core patterns bars dropping a stated restriction ("an unencodable qualifier never becomes an unqualified assertion"), yet "the rest of" is dropped and what remains, (End sk_give_1 night), is the Intervals section's "until Y" storage — the giving stopped when night came, roughly the converse of its spanning the night's remainder.

No word in the passage denotes a week, and the Time section forbids inventing a term the antecedent does not supply, so (During sk_fall_1 sk_persist_1) asserts containment in the eleven-day persistence that "during that week" does not state — you cannot point at the words that put that atom there.

Hedged counts are genuinely uncovered (Cardinality's magnitude is a native integer and ParticleFromNormal is defined only for Measure/clock magnitudes), and (CardinalityPhrase sk_nightmoths "about six") is a true, well-typed surface record of the phrase actually used — the calibration line licenses such improvisation, and failing to match a seeded lexicon string is the coverage gap the reviewer separately (and rightly) filed, not a parse defect.

gaps_confirmed: extent adverbial naming the remainder of a time period ("for the rest of the night") — no licensed carrier: Start/End take time terms, Measure duration needs a count, RestOf needs an entity/mass whole
degree adverb on a verb ("fell sharply") — the instruction set itself states such adverbs have no licensed slot and must be left out
anaphoric temporal NP at a granularity the antecedent never supplies ("during that week") — term propagation has no week-level term to copy
approximate/hedged count ("about six nightmoths") — Cardinality's magnitude is a native integer and CardinalityPhrase is specified for phrases with no number
ordinal/continuous day-count date in a non-Gregorian calendar ("day 121 of Year 1") — the Time terms assume a Gregorian Day-of-month inside a Month
new_gaps: "during <time-period NP>" has no head at all when the period is neither an eventuality nor a stated calendar term: During requires two reified eventualities and Time requires a term, so a licensed form would need a period-denoting term at week granularity (a Week/Quarter-style constructor) plus a containment head that accepts a period rather than an event

no head expresses "for the remainder of period P": RestOf ranges over entity/mass wholes, and a time period can never be an entity here (deictic and day-part times are bare constants and the Time section forbids minting an sk_ witness or Member atom for one), so a licensed form would need an interval whose Start is the event's onset and whose End is the period's own end
defect_summary: For "for the rest of the night" no compliant form is licensed — the give event should carry its class, roles and Past and no extent atom at all, with the extent recorded as a gap, since End/Start, Measure duration and RestOf each fail on a time period. For "during that week" the compliant form is likewise no temporal atom: with no week-denoting antecedent there is nothing to propagate, and no head may substitute the persistence eventuality for the week.
notes: The parse also omits the per-member distribution rule that Cardinality mandates for a counted plural with a distributive predicate ("drained six lanterns"), which the reviewer did not file. The reviewer's note about "each drained lantern" ranging over the six-lantern group is a defensible narrowing, not a defect — an (And (Member $x lantern) (Member $x drained)) range would also have been licensed.
